steps.name: looks-1-weather-packs
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; export PATH=/home/greg/.local/share/nodeenv-gorb/bin:$PATH; export ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang; node --check apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && node --check apps/weather/editor/weather-editor.js && grep -q "guilloche: { title: 'Guilloché'" apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && grep -q "charted: { title: 'Charted'" apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && grep -q "pack: 'guilloche'" apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && grep -q "pack: 'charted'" apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && ! grep -q "Flights · Modern" apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && ! grep -q "pack: 'engraved', c: { metal: '#C8CED6'" apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && ! grep -q "pack: 'pictogram', c: { ink: '#1F2A44'" apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && for p in phosphor engraved drafted folded nebula pictogram; do grep -q "pack: '$p'" apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js || exit 1; done && test "$(cat apps/weather/version.txt)" = v1.7.2 && python3 apps/weather/editor/_selftest/bake_check.py > /tmp/wx-bake.txt 2>&1 && tail -1 /tmp/wx-bake.txt && grep -qE '0 failed' /tmp/wx-bake.txt && ! grep -q '^FAIL ' /tmp/wx-bake.txt && make check-apps

steps.name: looks-2-flights-families
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; export PATH=/home/greg/.local/share/nodeenv-gorb/bin:$PATH; export ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang; node --check apps/flights/editor/flights-bake.js && node --check apps/flights/editor/flights-art.js && python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('apps/flights/art/make_art.py').read())" && grep -q "'station': ('Station'" apps/flights/art/make_art.py && grep -q "'sectional': ('Sectional'" apps/flights/art/make_art.py && grep -q 'def render_station' apps/flights/art/make_art.py && grep -q 'def render_sectional' apps/flights/art/make_art.py && python3 apps/flights/art/make_art.py && ls apps/flights/art/planes/station-single.svg apps/flights/art/planes/sectional-single.svg && grep -q '"station"' apps/flights/art/art.json && grep -q '"sectional"' apps/flights/art/art.json && grep -q "family: 'station'" apps/flights/editor/flights-bake.js && grep -q "family: 'sectional'" apps/flights/editor/flights-bake.js && grep -q "'sectional'\]" apps/flights/editor/flights-bake.js && test -z "$(git diff --name-only -- apps/flights/art/planes | grep -Ev '/(station|sectional)-')" && test "$(cat apps/flights/version.txt)" = v1.7.2 && python3 apps/flights/editor/_selftest/bake_check.py > /tmp/fl-bake.txt 2>&1 && tail -1 /tmp/fl-bake.txt && grep -qE '0 failed' /tmp/fl-bake.txt && ! grep -q '^FAIL ' /tmp/fl-bake.txt && make check-apps

steps.verify: set -o pipefail; export PATH=/home/greg/.local/share/nodeenv-gorb/bin:$PATH; export ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang; ! grep -qE 'Modern for flights|Radarscope' tools/rebake_shelf.py && ! grep -q 'Flights · Modern' apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && python3 tools/rebake_shelf.py --check && grep -q "pack: 'guilloche'" apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && grep -q "pack: 'charted'" apps/weather/editor/weather-bake.js && grep -q "\"station\"" apps/flights/art/art.json && grep -q "\"sectional\"" apps/flights/art/art.json && python3 apps/weather/editor/_selftest/bake_check.py > /tmp/wx3.txt 2>&1 && grep -qE '0 failed' /tmp/wx3.txt && ! grep -q '^FAIL ' /tmp/wx3.txt && python3 apps/flights/editor/_selftest/bake_check.py > /tmp/fl3.txt 2>&1 && grep -qE '0 failed' /tmp/fl3.txt && ! grep -q '^FAIL ' /tmp/fl3.txt && make check-apps && make check-editor
